植物细胞的吸水和失水 · 3D 互动课件: Water Uptake and Loss in Plant Cells · 3D Interactive Lesson
植物细胞的吸水和失水: Water Uptake and Loss in Plant Cells
外界浓度 > 细胞液 → 失水；外界浓度 < 细胞液 → 吸水: Outside concentration > cell sap → water loss; outside concentration < cell sap → water uptake
菜叶泡在清水里会变硬挺，撒了盐会出水——植物细胞怎样吸水和失水？: Leafy greens turn crisp in plain water and weep when salted. How do plant cells take up and lose water?
相当于半透膜，细胞壁全透: Acts as a semipermeable membrane; the cell wall is fully permeable
测浓度 · 判死活: Measure concentration · tell live from dead
紫色洋葱鳞片叶外表皮，滴管加液、吸水纸引流: Outer epidermis of a purple onion scale leaf; add liquid with a dropper and draw it through with blotting paper
一层 24 个细胞，紫色的是液泡里的细胞液: One layer of 24 cells; the purple is the cell sap in the vacuoles
磷脂双分子层与水通道蛋白；上方细胞内、下方细胞外: Phospholipid bilayer with aquaporins; inside the cell above, outside below
水为什么会穿过一层膜？: Why does water cross a membrane?
盯住膜看几秒：数一数水分子往哪边走得多: Watch the membrane for a few seconds: count which way more water molecules go
膜下方有蔗糖分子，它们过不去；水分子两边都在穿，从上方（水多的一侧）下去的更多: Below the membrane are sucrose molecules, which can't pass; water crosses both ways, but more goes down from above (the side with more water)
水：相对含量高 → 相对含量低: Water: higher relative content → lower relative content
半透膜：水能过，蔗糖不能过: Semipermeable membrane: water passes, sucrose doesn't
渗透作用：水分子通过半透膜的扩散。: Osmosis: the diffusion of water molecules through a semipermeable membrane.
方向：从水的相对含量高的一侧，到相对含量低的一侧。: Direction: from the side with higher relative water content to the side with lower.
玻璃纸是半透膜：水分子能自由透过，蔗糖分子不能。: Cellophane is a semipermeable membrane: water molecules pass freely, sucrose molecules don't.
去掉浓度差：两边水分子进出一样多，看不到净流动。: Remove the concentration difference: as many water molecules go in as out, with no net flow.
渗透的两个条件：有半透膜，膜两侧有浓度差。: Two conditions for osmosis: a semipermeable membrane, and a concentration difference across it.
半透膜两侧存在浓度差时，水分子从水的相对含量高的一侧向相对含量低的一侧渗透，这就: When there is a concentration difference across a semipermeable membrane, water molecules move from the side with higher relative water content to the side with lower. This is osmosis.
植物细胞里，哪一层相当于半透膜？: In a plant cell, which layer acts as the semipermeable membrane?
在剖开的细胞上点一下，找到原生质层: Tap the cut-open cell to find the protoplast layer
细胞剖开：外层是细胞壁，紧贴它的是原生质层，中间是紫色细胞液占满的中央液泡: The cell cut open: the outer layer is the cell wall, pressed against it is the protoplast layer, and the middle is the central vacuole full of purple cell sap
原生质层 = 细胞膜 + 细胞质 + 液泡膜: Protoplast layer = cell membrane + cytoplasm + vacuole membrane
细胞壁：全透，伸缩性小: Cell wall: fully permeable, not very elastic
中央液泡占据细胞的大部分空间，把细胞质挤成一薄层。: The central vacuole takes up most of the cell, squeezing the cytoplasm into a thin layer.
细胞膜、液泡膜和两层膜之间的细胞质合称原生质层。: The cell membrane, vacuole membrane and the cytoplasm between them together form the protoplast layer.
细胞壁对水全透，主要起保护和支持作用，伸缩性比较小。: The cell wall is fully permeable to water, mainly protects and supports, and is not very elastic.
去掉「原生质层」这个概念：就说不清水是穿过哪一层进出液泡的。: Without the idea of the "protoplast layer", you can't say which layer water crosses to enter and leave the vacuole.
质壁分离的「质」是原生质层，不是细胞质。: In plasmolysis, what pulls away from the wall is the protoplast layer, not just the cytoplasm.
细胞膜和液泡膜以及两层膜之间的细胞质称为原生质层，它相当于一层半透膜；细胞壁对水: The cell membrane, vacuole membrane and the cytoplasm between them form the protoplast layer, which acts as a semipermeable membrane; the cell wall is fully permeable to water.
滴入 0.3 g/mL 蔗糖溶液，细胞会怎样？: What happens to the cells when 0.3 g/mL sucrose solution is added?
把外界溶液浓度拖到 0.3 g/mL（教材用的浓度）: Drag the outside solution concentration to 0.3 g/mL (the textbook's concentration)
先从细胞的角上开始离壁（示意，刚开始分离），再整个缩成一团（已明显分离）；液泡变: The layer first pulls away from the wall at the cell's corners (illustrative, just starting to separate), then shrinks into a ball (clearly separated); the vacuole shrinks and the purple deepens; the cell's size barely changes; the count rises to 24 / 24
外界浓度 > 细胞液浓度 → 失水: Outside concentration > cell sap → water loss
0.3 g/mL 蔗糖溶液 · 吸水纸引流: 0.3 g/mL sucrose · drawn through with blotting paper
细胞液中的水透过原生质层进入外界溶液。: Water in the cell sap passes through the protoplast layer into the outside solution.
细胞壁和原生质层都有一定程度的收缩。: Both the cell wall and protoplast layer shrink somewhat.
原生质层比细胞壁伸缩性大，于是与细胞壁分离。: The protoplast layer is more elastic than the cell wall, so it separates from the wall.
去掉细胞壁（如动物细胞）：只会皱缩，看不到质壁分离。: Remove the cell wall (as in animal cells): the cell just shrivels, with no plasmolysis visible.
记录表三项：中央液泡大小、原生质层位置、细胞大小。: Three record-table columns: central vacuole size, protoplast layer position, cell size.
外界溶液浓度大于细胞液浓度时细胞失水；原生质层比细胞壁的伸缩性大，原生质层与细胞: When the outside concentration exceeds the cell sap's, the cell loses water; the protoplast layer is more elastic than the wall and gradually separates from it. This is plasmolysis.
细胞壁和原生质层之间，充满的是什么？: What fills the space between the cell wall and the protoplast layer?
看膜：水分子从哪条路走得多？: Watch the membrane: which path do more water molecules take?
水分子净流出细胞；大多经水通道蛋白，少数直接穿过磷脂双分子层: Water molecules flow out of the cell on net; most go through aquaporins, a few cross the phospholipid bilayer directly
分离后壁与原生质层之间充满外界溶液（学考通行结论；教材写的是细胞壁对水全透）。: After separation, the space between wall and protoplast layer is filled with outside solution (the standard exam conclusion; the textbook says the cell wall is fully permeable to water).
水分子更多借助水通道蛋白以协助扩散进出细胞。: Water molecules enter and leave cells mostly through aquaporins, by facilitated diffusion.
顺浓度梯度，不消耗能量，属于被动运输。: It goes down the concentration gradient without using energy, so it's passive transport.
去掉水通道蛋白：水仍能自由扩散过膜，但慢得多。: Remove the aquaporins: water still diffuses across the membrane freely, but much more slowly.
判断：水分子进入细胞只通过自由扩散——错。: True or false: water enters cells only by simple diffusion. False.
细胞壁对水全透，分离后壁与原生质层之间是外界溶液；水分子更多经水通道蛋白以协助扩: The cell wall is fully permeable to water, so after separation the space between wall and protoplast layer holds outside solution; water molecules enter and leave cells mostly through aquaporins by facilitated diffusion.
再滴清水，能复原吗？: Add plain water again. Can the cells recover?
把外界溶液浓度拖回 0（滴清水，吸水纸引流）: Drag the outside concentration back to 0 (add plain water, draw it through with blotting paper)
液泡变大、紫色变浅，原生质层慢慢回到细胞壁边，计数回到 0 / 24: The vacuole grows, the purple lightens, the protoplast layer slowly returns to the wall, and the count goes back to 0 / 24
外界浓度 < 细胞液浓度 → 吸水: Outside concentration < cell sap → water uptake
清水 · 吸水纸引流: Plain water · drawn through with blotting paper
外界溶液中的水透过原生质层进入细胞液。: Water from the outside solution passes through the protoplast layer into the cell sap.
整个原生质层慢慢恢复成原来的状态。: The whole protoplast layer slowly returns to its original state.
能复原，说明原生质层仍有选择透过性（由教材练习 2 推出）。: Recovery shows the protoplast layer is still selectively permeable (inferred from textbook exercise 2).
去掉这一步：只看到分离，证明不了水能双向进出。: Skip this step and you only see separation, which can't prove water moves both ways.
分离和复原合起来，才能说明原生质层相当于半透膜。: Only separation and recovery together show the protoplast layer acts as a semipermeable membrane.
外界溶液浓度小于细胞液浓度时细胞吸水，原生质层逐渐恢复原状，即质壁分离的复原。: When the outside concentration is below the cell sap's, the cell takes up water and the protoplast layer gradually returns to normal. This is deplasmolysis.
换成同样高浓度的甘油溶液，会怎样？: What happens with an equally concentrated glycerol solution instead?
把溶质从蔗糖换成甘油，等一会儿: Switch the solute from sucrose to glycerol and wait a while
先发生质壁分离，随后不用滴清水就自动复原: Plasmolysis happens first, then the cells recover on their own without adding water
甘油进入细胞 → 细胞液浓度升高 → 吸水: Glycerol enters the cell → cell sap concentration rises → water uptake
甘油：自由扩散进出细胞: Glycerol: enters and leaves cells by simple diffusion
甘油是脂溶性小分子，能自由扩散进入细胞。: Glycerol is a small fat-soluble molecule that can diffuse freely into cells.
刚开始外界浓度高，细胞失水分离。: At first the outside concentration is high, so the cells lose water and separate.
甘油进入后细胞液浓度升高，细胞重新吸水而复原。: Once glycerol enters, the cell sap concentration rises and the cells take up water again and recover.
教辅常见：KNO₃、尿素溶液中也会自动复原（教材未写）。: Common in study guides: cells also recover by themselves in KNO₃ or urea solutions (not in the textbook).
教材练习 3（答案见配套用书）：蔗糖中的甲细胞分离不复原，甘油中的乙细胞很快复原: Textbook exercise 3 (answers in the teacher's guide): cell A in sucrose separates and doesn't recover; cell B in glycerol quickly recovers.
溶质能进入细胞时（如甘油），细胞先失水分离，溶质进入后细胞液浓度升高，又吸水自动: When the solute can enter the cell (like glycerol), the cell first loses water and separates, then as the solute enters, the cell sap concentration rises and the cell takes up water and recovers by itself.
怎样测出细胞液的浓度？: How can you measure the concentration of the cell sap?
把浓度从 0 一点点往上加，看计数从几开始增加: Raise the concentration from 0 bit by bit and see at what value the count starts to rise
计数一个一个增加：每个细胞的细胞液浓度不同（设定），浓度越高分离的细胞越多: The count goes up one by one: each cell's sap concentration is different (setting), and the higher the concentration, the more cells separate
细胞液浓度 ≈ 刚好不分离与刚开始分离之间: Cell sap concentration ≈ between just not separating and just starting to separate
一组浓度梯度的蔗糖溶液: A gradient series of sucrose solutions
配一组浓度由低到高的蔗糖溶液，分别观察。: Prepare a series of sucrose solutions from low to high concentration and observe each.
细胞液浓度介于「不分离」与「刚分离」的两个浓度之间。: The cell sap concentration lies between the two concentrations of "no separation" and "just separating".
拨到「死细胞」再加浓度：细胞不再吸水失水，不发生质壁分离。: Switch to "Dead cells" and raise the concentration: the cells no longer gain or lose water, and no plasmolysis occurs.
去掉浓度梯度：只用一种浓度，只能说「高于」或「低于」。: Without a concentration gradient: with only one concentration, you can only say "higher than" or "lower than".
质壁分离能判断成熟植物细胞的死活（教材练习 2，答案见配套用书）。: Plasmolysis can tell whether mature plant cells are alive or dead (textbook exercise 2, answers in the teacher's guide).
用一组浓度梯度的蔗糖溶液处理，细胞液浓度介于刚好不发生和刚发生质壁分离的两个浓度: Treat with a gradient series of sucrose solutions; the cell sap concentration lies between the two concentrations at which plasmolysis just doesn't and just does occur; dead cells don't undergo plasmolysis.
考核：测一测这片表皮的细胞液浓度: Assessment: measure the cell sap concentration of this epidermis
调外界溶液浓度，让发生质壁分离的细胞在 10–14 个之间，保持 15 秒: Adjust the outside concentration so that 10–14 cells are plasmolyzed, and hold for 15 seconds
达标横幅；中途会有一次「滴错了浓度」，要重新调回: Pass banner; partway through there's one "wrong concentration added" that you must adjust back
约一半细胞分离时，外界浓度大约就是这片表皮细胞液浓度的中间值。: When about half the cells are separated, the outside concentration is roughly the middle value of this epidermis's cell sap concentrations.
溶质必须是蔗糖：甘油会进入细胞，计数会回落。: The solute must be sucrose: glycerol enters the cells and the count drops back.
只能用活细胞：死细胞不分离。: Only live cells work: dead cells don't separate.
没有新内容：前七步都用上就能达标。: Nothing new: using the first seven steps is enough to pass.
测细胞液浓度的思路：浓度梯度 + 观察是否分离。: Approach for measuring cell sap concentration: concentration gradient + check for separation.
考核没有新结论：用浓度梯度找到约一半细胞分离的浓度。: The assessment has no new conclusion: use a concentration gradient to find where about half the cells separate.
细胞液浓度为设定: Cell sap concentrations are set values
已加热处理：细胞死亡（示意），形态不再变化: Heat-treated: cells are dead (illustrative) and no longer change shape
主角原生质体体积—时间: Main cell protoplast volume vs time
滴错了浓度：外界溶液变成了 0.3 g/mL: Wrong concentration added: the outside solution became 0.3 g/mL
质壁分离中的「质」指的是: In plasmolysis, the part that pulls away from the wall is the
细胞膜、液泡膜和两层膜之间的细胞质合称原生质层（p.63）。: The cell membrane, vacuole membrane and the cytoplasm between them together form the protoplast layer (p.63).
发生质壁分离后，细胞壁和原生质层之间充满的是: After plasmolysis, the space between the cell wall and the protoplast layer is filled with
细胞壁孔隙大，外界溶液能进入（学考通行结论；教材 p.63 写的是「对于水分子来: The cell wall has large pores, so the outside solution can enter (the standard exam conclusion; textbook p.63 says "the cell wall is fully permeable to water molecules").
水分子进出细胞: Water molecules enter and leave cells
更多借助水通道蛋白协助扩散: Mostly by facilitated diffusion through aquaporins
水分子更多借助水通道蛋白以协助扩散方式进出细胞（p.67）。: Water molecules enter and leave cells mostly through aquaporins by facilitated diffusion (p.67).
放在比细胞液浓度高的甘油溶液里，细胞会: In a glycerol solution more concentrated than the cell sap, the cell will
分离后自动复原: Separate and then recover by itself
甘油自由扩散进入细胞，细胞液浓度升高后重新吸水（p.66–67）。: Glycerol diffuses freely into the cell, and once the cell sap concentration rises the cell takes up water again (pp.66–67).
看懂植物细胞怎样吸水和失水，会用质壁分离测细胞液浓度。: Understand how plant cells take up and lose water, and use plasmolysis to measure cell sap concentration.
示意声明：细胞放大 200 倍、膜为示意放大；细胞液浓度为设定值；时间已加速。: Disclaimer: cells shown at 200× and the membrane is a schematic close-up; cell sap concentrations are set values; time is sped up.
